bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of leading commercial Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems on audio snippets transcribed from Black versus white speakers.

Evaluating the Word Error Rate (WER) of commercial Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems across gender lines to identify disparities (e.g., finding the highest error rates specifically among Black men).

Referencing the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Face Recognition Vendor Test (FRVT), which evaluates algorithmic performance and false non-match rates (FNMR) with a focus on bias across various demographic groups.
